snippet.title: The Coach Never Expected This From a Kid! 🤯
snippet.description:
#shorts #shortsfeed #sports #fitness

Credit to: @occrush_fritchle via Instagram. 

When this coach underestimated his students, he made a huge mistake.
Because he made a bet that his students wouldn’t be able to hit these baseball bats from 200 feet away.
But soon he realized how wrong that decision was.
As soon as the kids started throwing the balls, it looked like the coach was actually right — because none of them could hit the bats.
So, to make it easier, the coach added two more bats.
But even then, they couldn’t hit any of them, as their aim was completely off.
But when this one boy stepped in, he showed everyone how it’s really done.
